question: Do the 3D transitions and title entrances in the reel look right?
context: Reel: queue/audits/2026-10-11-depth-reel-contact.png and one 3 s MP4 and GIF per move beside it. Already built at Next defaults; this card only tunes them.

options.label: Keep all six transitions and four entrances as filmed
options.summary: Flip, Cube, Swing, Doorway, Revolve and Push in depth stay in the tiles and menus, and Swing In, Flip Up, Fly In From Depth and Tilt Settle stay in the title Part In menu, exactly as the reel shows them.
pros: Everything in the reel ships as it is
The title rework can start from these moves today
cons: Swing and Revolve both swing a shot on an edge, so they may read alike
options.mitigation: Each one is a few numbers in one file, so a move you dislike can be retuned without touching the rest.

options.label: Keep them, but retune Swing, Revolve and Doorway
options.summary: The same twelve moves, with Swing, Revolve and Doorway changed after you say what is off about them (for example doors that stay in the frame longer, or a revolve that turns about the middle).
pros: Fixes the moves most likely to look alike or too quick
cons: Another round before those three are final
options.mitigation: The other moves are unaffected and stay as filmed.

options.label: Ship only Flip, Cube and Push in depth, plus Swing In and Fly In From Depth
options.summary: The three transitions and two entrances that read most clearly stay; Swing, Doorway, Revolve, Flip Up and Tilt Settle come out of the tiles and menus.
pros: A shorter list that is easier to choose from
cons: Fewer produced-looking moves for the title rework to use
options.mitigation: The removed moves stay in the code and can come back with one line each.
